LanguageData.RimGamble.RickyRiskDesc: Ricky loves the thrill of chance. He will periodically send events of increased magnitude - both positive and negative. A messenger will be sent to inform your colony of these occurrences in advance.
LanguageData.RimGamble.TravelingGamblerDropPodDesc: The Traveling Gambler has gifted you a loot crate. They thank you for allowing them to stay.
